title: Clean form — visible labels, blur validation, focus chaining, guarded submit
notes: The build agent's own output handed back for review. Everything on its checklist is present: visible labels rather than placeholders, validation on blur, specific error text announced with role=alert, correct keyboardType/autoComplete/textContentType, focus chaining with the last field submitting, submit disabled while in flight, server-side field errors mapped back with focus moved, safe-area padding, keyboardShouldPersistTaps, and one zod schema as the source of both the type and the validation. Testing that the agent recognises correct work instead of finding something to say.

forbid.name: claims placeholders are used instead of labels
claims the submit button is not guarded against double submission
claims errors are not announced to screen readers
recommends validating on change instead of blur
recommends moving form state into a global store
